expectations.text: B1: Proposes a concrete small local corpus and stays in the workspace
expectations.evidence: All proposed corpora are remote or outside the workspace: 'Hacker News (Algolia API)', 'Wikipedia', 'Project Gutenberg', 'Stack Exchange data dumps (archive.org)', 'Your own machine — index your notes, code, or PDFs'. No small local corpus inside the workspace is proposed; recommendation is 'start with HN via Algolia'.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Answer ends with 'Recommendation: start with HN via Algolia for a fast end-to-end loop... One caveat: HN titles are short...' — no concrete command to run and no expected output/behaviour is given (only a bare API URL, no runnable command).

expectations.text: B3: Suggests a concrete corpus (e.g. local markdown/docs, Wikipedia abstracts, or a small generated set)
expectations.evidence: 'Hacker News (Algolia API) — easiest. No auth, returns JSON, one HTTP call per page: https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search_by_date?tags=story&hitsPerPage=1000' plus Wikipedia, Gutenberg, Stack Exchange dumps — concrete corpora suggested.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: 'FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0)' and 'SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0)'; only tool call was glob {"pattern": "**/*"}. No install command run and nothing written outside the workspace.
